item.title: Updated top-up usage allowances
item.summary: New top-ups allocate 80% of the purchase price to AI usage, matching paid plans.
item.details: Purchase prices stay the same: $5, $10, $20, and $25 purchases provide $4, $8, $16, and $20 of metered usage capacity. This also applies to Family top-ups, group contributions, and new automatic group refills. Existing balances and purchases already started keep their original usage amounts.
